title: The Grand Terrace: Ed Fox, Roy and Chu, and a full rehearsal
summary: In Chicago the band had Roy Eldridge, Chu Berry, Buster Bailey and Slick Jones. Ed Fox was exacting, and a full rehearsal was called for Billie Holiday and then Babe Matthews.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: a funny situation happened. We rehearsed all day but Roy and I had worked and Chu had joined the band at Roseland to get the band in shape.
Yeah, Roy, Chu, we had a helluva band there. We had a helluva band before they came in but Smack wanted Roy and Chu and Buster was always there. And Slick Jones.

He comes in a little later. Talking about the greatest drummer in the world, aren't you? Uh huh. An intelligent drummer, better believe it. So what happened, we hit Chicago so we do this and talk to Baby about Ed Fox, the Grand Terrace, and it takes me right back to Webster Groves, right between Webster Groves and St. Louis. That was a man who had tremendous ideas about the way he wanted everything to be seen in this cabaret. That was his home, he meant it. He meant it all the way. And, so one day they called, chops are hanging down from your nose all the way down to your nails and blisters showing up and all that sort of thing, you know. So, ... I never called him Ed Fox. I called Joe Gustadt, Joe Gustadt. I didn't call Mr. Langford, P.B. I called them a lot of things behind their backs but (?.) so one day, Stanley, I had a corn show up on my chops those were the names given to me so I used them and they called a full rehearsal. Now, sometimes you rehease for an act that comes in, they called for a full rehearsal so I said, Who in the hell is this

for? A full rehearsal? That means hours, you know. The full rehearsal, I talked to Roy. I said, Who's the full rehearsal for? Do you know Babe Matthews? I said, No, I don't. Well, Billie Holiday had been there and Billie was accustomed to working with a smaller clubs. She was beautiful, beautiful voice and all that kind of thing but she's accustomed to smaller rooms. And they put her in a big room and she was, you know. But, I was very fond of Billie. I knew her through the years. And, so to follow her was Babe Matthews. Henderson's band was to start the show. Somewhere, I don't know, I think it might have been Roy ... it could have been, you know, and the theme song. And we were playing (he sings tune) so we got in this rehearsal. We rehearsed all the damn day to get this thing together and she came out with the idea, I introduced... Henderson was the star of the show. ... you tell them, Baby, I can't talk about that, you know.
